text.insert: SyncState is the durable state structure for one sync workflow within HarnessState. It records observed intake, isolated reconciliation, recovery and cancellation evidence, and the confirmed publication boundary without restating the sync algorithm. The

. The envelope supplies shared workflow identity, status, revision, trace lineage, event cursor, timestamps, and blockers; SyncState supplies the sync-specific observation, staging, recovery, cancellation, and publication projections.

The workflow state keeps canonical cycle state unchanged while reconciliation is staged. Nullable recovery, cancellation, and publication records distinguish resumable work, a proven pre-publication abort, and the irreversible published boundary.

props.description: Sync workflow: intake identity, staging progress, PR-branch reconciliation, and the atomic publication record.

fields.name: intake
fields.description: What this sync ingests. Captured when the operator starts sync.

fields.name: upstream_from
fields.description: Cycle head's upstream anchor before sync.

fields.name: upstream_to
fields.description: Observed upstream target. Equals upstream_from on a knowledge-only pass.

fields.name: corpus_batch_ids
fields.description: Staged corpora such as Discord awaiting publication.

fields.name: knowledge_only
fields.description: True when upstream did not move; reconciliation is skipped and only the knowledge revision advances.

fields.name: staging
fields.description: Isolated workspace where all reconciliation happens; null on a knowledge-only pass.

fields.name: pr_reconciliation
fields.description: One entry per open PR series rebased alongside the cycle.

fields.name: pushed
fields.description: True once the reconciled branch is pushed to its upstream PR at publish.

fields.name: publication
fields.description: Set by the atomic publish step; null until then.

fields.name: remote_application_id
fields.description: Boundary recorded in the cycle timeline; absent on a knowledge-only pass.

fields.name: invalidated_ids
fields.description: Targets, checkpoints, and PR snapshots explicitly invalidated by the boundary.

props.name: SyncState

text.insert: Within HarnessState, the sync slot exposes one durable answer for the workflow's current identity, status, progress, blockers, and accepted boundary records. Observation can advance without dispatch authority, while staging mutations require sync to hold the dispatch lease. Canonical cycle and knowledge state change only when the publication projection is committed from validated staging.

The state also preserves enough evidence to choose a safe continuation after interruption. Recovery identifies whether staging survives and where processing resumes; cancellation proves canonical source remained untouched; publication identifies the accepted source and knowledge revisions plus every invalidated dependent identity.
